profile_text.body:
Cartesia is an AI startup founded in 2023 and based in San Francisco, California. The company describes itself as creating "AI that learns and interacts like humans." Its team has pioneered work on breakthrough AI architectures including state space models (SSMs), Mamba, and H-Nets, with research aimed at developing AI systems that learn from and interact with the world in human-like ways.

The company's primary product is Sonic-3.6, a streaming text-to-speech API designed to generate natural, expressive voices with laughter capabilities across 44 languages. Sonic-3.6 is built for AI agents and interactive applications. Cartesia operates as a for-profit startup and maintains a presence in California, where the company faces legal exposure across 220 cases in the state.
